SR-G1.equip: a huge cracked fang is pressed onto a fist, hide cords are pulled tight with creaks, and a low hungry growl-like rumble swells from the stone

G1-01.en: Young Bison of the Duel Ring
G1-01.ko: 작은 주먹을 서툴게 휘두름 · 맨몸으로 맞고 휘청
G1-01.atk: a young fighter swings a bare fist: a quick leathery wrist-wrap creak, a light whoosh, then a modest knuckle thump on hide armour with a small puff of breath
G1-01.def: no guard at all, the youngster stumbles: a soft fleshy thud, a scuff of boots on packed dirt, a rattle of loose bone charms against a leather strap

G1-03.ko: 꽥꽥대며 돌을 집어 던짐 · 맞고 깩 소리 내며 튀어 물러남
G1-03.atk: a barking hoot and chattering teeth, hands scrabbling over loose pebbles, then a flung stone whistles across the gap and cracks against hide with a sharp clack
G1-03.def: no real guard, the lean ape is knocked back: a soft fur-muffled thump, a shrill screech, palms and feet scrabbling over gravel as it bounds away

G1-04.ko: 짧게 낄낄대며 달려들어 묾 · 어깨로 받고 이를 갊
G1-04.atk: a squeaky juvenile giggle, small paws pattering on dry grass, a scrabbling lunge and a sharp clacking nip that tugs at leather
G1-04.def: it ducks a shoulder into the hit: a light thump on coarse spotted fur, a short whining huff, and teeth grinding in stubborn defiance

G1-05.ko: 웃음소리 내며 맴돌다 뼈째 묾 · 털가죽으로 버팀
G1-05.atk: a rising whooping call, paws circling through dry grass, then a lunging bite that closes with a wet crunch of bone-crushing jaws
G1-05.def: coarse spotted fur takes the blow: a dull hide thump, a low cackling grunt, claws digging into packed dirt as it holds its ground

G1-07.ko: 달리며 활을 쏨 · 말 몸으로 비켜 받고 콧김
G1-07.atk: drumming hooves gather pace across hard steppe, a horn bow creaks and snaps, an arrow hisses through the air and thunks into hide
G1-07.def: lightly armoured, the horse body sidesteps: a dull thump on dun hide, a startled snort, hooves skidding on dry earth and a leather quiver rattling

G1-08.ko: 돌날개로 덮쳐 발톱으로 이음매를 긁어 찢음 · 돌 몸으로 막고 부스러기
G1-08.atk: heavy stone wings crack open with a gritty grind, a short swooping whoosh, then a shrill stony screech as hooked talons rake through armour seams
G1-08.def: it hunches its rock body against the blow: a hard stone-on-metal knock, a dry grinding of joints, and small chips pinging away onto gravel

G1-10.ko: 땅을 갈며 돌진해 돌엄니로 들이받음 · 두꺼운 가죽으로 받음
G1-10.atk: a heavy snorting grunt, hooves churning soil like a plough, a thundering charge and a stony crack as tusks smash through wood and plank
G1-10.def: bristly mud-caked hide takes the blow: a thick dull thump, coarse hairs rasping, and a wheezing snort as it shrugs off the impact

G1-11.ko: 흑요석 창이 날아가 박히고 부서짐 · 창 자루로 쳐냄
G1-11.atk: a long wooden shaft whips back and thrusts: a thin whistle, a glassy obsidian crack as the blade shatters inside the target, and splinters tinkling to the ground
G1-11.def: he parries with the spear shaft: a sharp wooden clack, a short vibrating twang, a slide of boots, and a faint scatter of obsidian shards ticking against stone

G1-12.ko: 바위를 번쩍 들어 던져 쾅 · 돌 몸으로 맞고 자갈 쏟아짐
G1-12.atk: stone fingers grind as they grip a boulder, a low gravelly heave, a whooshing arc through the air and a huge crunching boom as the boulder shatters on impact
G1-12.def: unguarded, the young stone body rocks back: a flat heavy knock, gravel trickling from fresh cracks, and a long grinding scrape of stone feet

G1-13.ko: 꽥 울며 노려보고 쪼아 굳힘 · 자갈 깃털로 받음
G1-13.atk: a harsh rooster-like screech, stiff wings flapping with a rattle of pebbles, then a hard beak peck and a dry stony crackle spreading where it strikes
G1-13.def: the pebble-crusted feathers take the hit: a gritty knock, loose gravel rattling off its back, a scaly tail scraping the ground and an indignant cluck

G1-14.ko: 머리 숙이고 뿔로 돌진해 뚫음 · 어깨로 받고 콧김
G1-14.atk: a deep bellowing snort and a stamp of hooves, a rolling charge over hard earth, then curved horns punch straight through with a splintering crash
G1-14.def: it lowers its horned head into the blow: a heavy thud on thick bull hide, an iron nose ring clinking, hooves grinding into the dirt and a hot furious snort

G1-15.ko: 쉭 소리 내며 흑요 발톱으로 긁음 · 유리 비늘로 딸깍 받음
G1-15.atk: a dry rattling hiss, glassy claws clicking over rock, then a lightning swipe that scrapes with a thin obsidian screech and a creeping stony tick
G1-15.def: black glassy scales take the blow: a sharp brittle clack, the long body scraping sideways on stone, and a low warning hiss

G1-18.ko: 북 두드려 땅을 울려 솟구침 · 두꺼운 배로 둔탁하게 받음
G1-18.atk: a slow heavy drum thump, a deep guttural growl, then a low earth rumble surges along the ground and bursts up under the target with a gritty crunch
G1-18.def: no guard, the big body soaks it: a meaty belly thump, a grunt of annoyance, bone charms rattling and a drum skin buzzing faintly

G1-19.ko: 곰이 일어서 앞발로 내려침 · 바위 박힌 등으로 받음
G1-19.atk: a deep chesty bear growl, a huge body rising with a creak of leather harness, then heavy paws crashing down with a thunderous slam and splitting rock chips
G1-19.def: the rocks embedded in the bear's back take it: a hollow stony clonk, matted fur rasping, a deep annoyed huff and a harness strap groaning under the weight

G1-21.ko: 달리며 흑요 화살을 쏨 · 말 몸을 틀어 받음
G1-21.atk: galloping hooves on hard ground, a heavy bow drawn with a deep creak, then a whistling obsidian arrow that bursts with a glassy crack on impact
G1-21.def: the horse body twists aside: a glancing thump on hide, a sharp snort, hooves scraping as it wheels, and loose arrows clattering in a quiver

G1-23.ko: 배에 맨 북을 쾅쾅 울리고 주먹으로 내리침 · 북 가죽으로 맞고 웅 울림
G1-23.atk: a huge hand pounds a bearskin drum strapped to a belly, booming beats speeding up, a roar, then a heavy fist slam with a meaty thud
G1-23.def: the blow lands on the drum: a deep hollow boom that rings out, a grunt from the ogre's belly, leather straps creaking and bone rattles shaking

G1-24.ko: 낄낄 웃음에 무리가 몰려들어 묾 · 갈기로 받고 낮게 으르렁
G1-24.atk: a long whooping cackle rises across the steppe, answering giggles close in from all sides, then a heavy bite crunches through leather with a wet crack
G1-24.def: a coarse mane takes the hit: a dull thump, a low rumbling growl that turns into a menacing titter, paws digging into dirt

G1-25.ko: 땅이 움찔하며 바위 주먹이 내리꽂힘 · 돌 몸으로 버팀
G1-25.atk: a stone fist grinds closed, the ground trembles with a low sub rumble, then a colossal downward punch lands with a deep earth-cracking boom and rolling dust
G1-25.def: its body is living stone: the strike lands with a flat heavy thud, small cracks tick across its surface, loose gravel jumps on the ground, and it barely shifts

G1-26.ko: 묵직한 곤봉이 갑옷을 뚫음 · 뼈 갑옷이 쩍 갈라지며 받음
G1-26.atk: a massive bone club drags on the ground then swings up, cutting the air with a heavy whomp and punching clean through plate with a ringing crack and a crumple
G1-26.def: bone armour plates take the blow: a hard clacking crunch, a hairline split spidering through the bone, a pause, then a deep low grunt-free thud as he stands firm

G1-27.ko: 일어서서 앞발로 내리침 · 두꺼운 털로 받고 포효
G1-27.atk: a deep chesty growl echoing like a cave, a massive body rising on hind legs, then heavy paws crashing down with a thunderous slam
G1-27.def: thick shaggy fur swallows the blow: a dense muffled thump, a deep protective roar, claws gouging the earth without a step back

G1-28.ko: 들소 떼가 땅을 울리며 들이받음 · 덥수룩한 앞몸으로 받음
G1-28.atk: a distant rumble swelling into a thundering stampede of hooves, deep lowing calls, then a crushing wave of horns and bodies slamming through
G1-28.def: shaggy humped fronts take the hit: heavy thuds on matted fur, snorting and lowing, hooves stamping in place and dust billowing

G1-29.ko: 땅 밑에서 바위 기둥이 솟아 막음째 꿰뚫음 · 바위가 흩어졌다 다시 뭉침
G1-29.atk: a very slow subterranean hum, boulders grinding into place, then a column of stone bursts up through any guard with a deep piercing crack
G1-29.def: the blow knocks boulders loose: a heavy stony clatter, gravel cascading, then a low rumble as the rocks roll back together

G1-32.ko: 굵은 꼬리를 휘둘러 후려침 · 흑요 비늘로 받음
G1-32.atk: heavy clawed footfalls, a deep throaty hiss, then a thick tail whips around with a whooshing lash and a crushing slap
G1-32.def: black obsidian scales take the blow: a hard glassy clack, claws scraping on stone, a heavy body shifting with a low hiss

G1-33.ko: 느린 걸음 끝에 바위 주먹을 내리꽂음 · 돌 몸이 깊게 울림
G1-33.atk: slow grinding stone footsteps, a long low rumble as a great arm lifts, then a fist like a rockfall lands with a deep earth-cracking boom
G1-33.def: the stone body barely notices: a deep hollow knock, gravel and moss sliding off its shoulders, and a long grinding settle

G1-34.ko: 뱀 머리칼이 쉭쉭대며 노려봐 막음째 굳힘 · 돌 살갗으로 받음
G1-34.atk: a many-voiced hiss of stone snakes, a low humming stare building, then a dry crackle of stone spreading through the target, ending in a brittle crunch
G1-34.def: her grey stone skin takes the hit: a hard chalky knock, snakes recoiling with a sharp hiss, and small flakes of stone pattering down

G1-35.ko: 땅을 뚫고 솟아 집어삼킴 · 바위 마디로 받음
G1-35.atk: a deep tunnelling rumble beneath the ground, earth cracking open with a roar, then a stone-toothed maw slams shut with a grinding crunch
G1-35.def: rock-plated segments take the blow: a heavy stony clunk, segments grinding against each other, soil and gravel pouring off

G1-36.ko: 포효하며 돌도끼를 내리찍음 · 뿔을 낮추고 버팀
G1-36.atk: a thunderous bellow, a heavy stone-headed axe swung overhead with a deep whoosh, then a ground-shaking chop and a splintering crack
G1-36.def: it braces with horns lowered: a solid thud on thick hide and leather harness, hooves grinding into the earth, and a long hot snort

G1-41.ko: 거북 등딱지 방패로 밀침 · 방패로 둔탁하게 막음
G1-41.atk: a heavy shuffling step, a grunt, then a giant turtle-shell shield shoves forward with a hollow knocking thump
G1-41.def: the turtle shell takes it full on: a deep hollow clonk that rings low, the ogre grunting and sliding back a heel on packed dirt

G1-42.ko: 비늘 끝으로 툭 밀침 · 칼이 튕겨 나가는 돌비늘 울림
G1-42.atk: a huge slab of scale tilts with a slow grinding scrape and nudges forward, landing a dull slate-like knock
G1-42.def: the blade meets layered dragon scale: a bright ringing clank as steel glances off, a deep resonant stony hum, and pebbles rattling off the turf on its face

G1-43.ko: 바위가 굴러와 툭 밂 · 바위가 벽처럼 솟아 막음
G1-43.atk: a loose boulder rolls forward with a gravelly grind and bumps the target with a soft stony knock
G1-43.def: the ground rumbles and rocks heave up into a wall: a deep crunching rise of stone, the blow landing with a dull flat thud, gravel trickling down the face

SP-G1.ko: 잿불 바위주먹이 꿰뚫고 연타 · 바위 몸에 불꽃이 튐
SP-G1.atk: a smoldering ember crackle surrounds a fist of living rock, a heavy grinding wind-up, then rapid piercing punches that drive through with cracking stone booms, each trailing a hiss of hot ash
SP-G1.def: his body of rock and embers takes the hit: a deep stony clang with sparks and glowing ash puffing off, a faint crackling of cooling coals and a low earth rumble beneath

UN-G1.ko: 뼈 곤봉 내려치자 늑대 떼 달려옴 · 늑대털 갑옷으로 받음
UN-G1.atk: a hefty bone-tipped warclub smashes down with a dull crack, then answering wolf howls ring out in the distance, pawsteps closing fast and snarls tearing in from every side
UN-G1.def: a heavy wolf-pelt mantle over bone plates takes the blow: a thick muffled thump, coarse fur rasping, bone rattling together, and a menacing low growl from nearby wolves

UN-G1-7.ko: 주운 무기로 번갈아 휘두름 · 쇠 방패 조각으로 막음
UN-G1-7.atk: a scavenged blade is snatched up with a metallic scrape, tossed and swung in a wide arc, clanging against a second weapon, then a brutal chopping smash that rattles loot-laden belts
UN-G1-7.def: he blocks with a mismatched hoard of stolen armour: a chaotic clanging of dented plates and chains, a hard metal knock and a jingling of dropped coins and loose rings

EP-G1-1.ko: 외눈 투사의 흑요 건틀릿 일격 · 굵은 팔로 비껴 막음
EP-G1-1.atk: a guttural one-eyed roar, a massive fist in an obsidian-studded gauntlet whooshes in, then a glassy crack and a bone-deep crunch as it lands
EP-G1-1.def: a huge forearm takes a glancing block: a thick meaty thump, obsidian studs grating, a heavy stamp and a scornful grunt

EP-G1-2.ko: 털코뿔소가 뿔로 들이받고 다음 대열로 내달림 · 털가죽으로 받음
EP-G1-2.atk: a heavy snort and thundering hooves, a rider's war cry, a horn smashing through with a splintering crunch, then the charge thunders straight on into the next rank
EP-G1-2.def: shaggy wool and thick hide take the blow: a dense muffled thump, a deep irritated huff, hooves pawing and harness leather creaking

EP-G1-3.ko: 뼈 곤봉 일격이 급소를 부숨 · 흑요 갑옷에 맞고 꿈쩍 않음
EP-G1-3.atk: a measured step on mountain rock, a long breath, then a massive spiked club descends with a roaring whoosh, driving through with a razor-sharp crack and a ground-shaking boom
EP-G1-3.def: thick stone plating on his torso takes the strike: a dense metallic stony clang, sparks, a deep resonant rumble, and the mountain wind briefly the only thing that moves

PN-G1-C1.ko: 작은 몸으로 주먹을 뚫고 박음 · 이를 악물고 서서 버팀
PN-G1-C1.atk: a small clenched fist cuts the air with a hard whip, bone charms click together, and a surprisingly dense thump punches clean through with a short stony crack
PN-G1-C1.def: a stubborn child's stance on bare feet: a dull slap on tough skin, boots digging into dirt, gritted teeth grinding, and a defiant stomp that stops any slide backward

PN-G1-C3.ko: 바윗덩이 몸으로 들이받음 · 바위가 덜그럭대며 받음
PN-G1-C3.atk: boulders grind together as the hulk lurches forward, a rolling rumble, then a crushing body slam with a booming crack and rubble flying
PN-G1-C3.def: the loosely bound boulders take the hit: a heavy stony clatter, rocks shifting and knocking, dust puffing out of the seams

PN-G1-U2.ko: 곰이 된 몸으로 앞발을 내리쳐 찢음 · 제 털가죽으로 버팀
PN-G1-U2.atk: a fierce guttural snarl twisting into a bear's roar, heavy clawed paws swinging wide with a whomp, then ripping through armour with a tearing crunch
PN-G1-U2.def: its own thick pelt swallows the blow: a dense muffled thump, coarse fur puffing, a defiant deep growl and clawed feet digging in without a step back

PN-G1-R.ko: 재 묻은 주먹이 급소를 정확히 침 · 어깨 흙갑옷으로 견딤
PN-G1-R.atk: trailing footsteps in ash, a creak of a leather glove tightening, then a sharply aimed fist cracks into a weak point with a snap that is dry and cutting
PN-G1-R.def: a dusty earth-streaked pauldron takes the hit: a hard dry knock, ash puffing off, a long steady exhale through the nose and boots grinding firmly in place

PN-G1-E.ko: 나팔 울음 뒤 엄니로 쓸어 연달아 들이받음 · 긴 털로 받음
PN-G1-E.atk: a trumpeting blast echoing off the mountain, earth-shaking footsteps, then great tusks sweep through one foe and crash into the next with a heavy ivory crack
PN-G1-E.def: long shaggy wool and a rock-crusted brow take the hit: a heavy muffled thud, stones knocking, and a deep rumbling snort

UP-G1-11.ko: 흑요 창끝을 능숙하게 찌름 · 창대를 돌려 팽팽히 막음
UP-G1-11.atk: a practiced spin of a long spear, a razor-thin whistle, three crisp volcanic glass tips clicking on the shaft, and a deep driving thrust that cracks cleanly through armour
UP-G1-11.def: he whirls the long haft to deflect: a rapid wooden clack against the incoming blow, a sharp twang of the shaft flexing, a steady planted step and shards chiming softly

UP-G1-18.ko: 세 북과 오우거 포효에 땅이 솟구침 · 돌 방벽이 겹쳐 막음
UP-G1-18.atk: three heavy shaman drums thump in unison with a deep guttural ogre growl, the ground answers with a rising rumble, and jagged stone erupts in a grinding crash
UP-G1-18.def: layered stone slabs rise around the towering ogre: a double grinding heave, a dense rock thud, heavy leather drum skins quivering as dust settles

UP-G1-24.ko: 길게 낄낄대는 울음에 대무리가 몰려 물어뜯음 · 덥수룩한 갈기로 받음
UP-G1-24.atk: a long whooping cackle rolls across the steppe, many giggles answer and close in from all sides, then heavy jaws crunch through leather with a wet crack
UP-G1-24.def: a thick coarse mane takes the hit: a heavy thump, a low rumbling growl turning into a menacing titter, paws digging into dirt

MC-01.ko: 늑대 무리가 이빨을 감추고 엎드리자 적의 칼끝이 머뭇거림
MC-01.cast: a pack of wolves sinks low with a soft rustle of fur and dry grass, a long held low growl hums under the breath, then a muffled sagging whoosh as enemy blades falter and droop, ending in a tense hush

MG-01.cast: a rustle of hide behind the line, teeth clicking and bared, then a rush of many boots and paws leaps past with a gathering whoosh, ending in a sharp snapping bite

MG-04.ko: 쓰러진 형제들의 이름을 부를수록 주먹이 무거워져 내리꽂힘
MG-04.cast: a low growl muttering a few heavy beats like names being counted, each beat a deeper stony thud as a fist grows heavier, then one crushing downward slam with a grinding crack

SG1-01.cast: sharp whistles and short hunting barks, scattering hooves and stumbling steps pushed forward, a panicked bleat cut short

MG-05.ko: 발 구르기에 땅이 울려 멀리까지 떨림
MG-05.cast: a heavy stomp pounds the ground in unison, a deep tremor rolls outward through loose gravel, pebbles bouncing and rattling, and a distant rumbling shudder fading into dust

SG1-02.cast: a low guttural grunt, then a quick string of short heavy chops and blunt thuds landing one after another down a line, each ending a ragged wheeze, and a final hush

SG1-03.ko: 몰린 무리가 맨 앞 적의 무기 · 갑옷 · 숨통을 차례로 뜯음
SG1-03.cast: a pack lunges with a sudden snarl, three rapid snapping bites in a row, claws scraping metal, armour ripping with a tearing rasp, a wet crunch at the throat, then a heavy body thuds down as the growl rushes on

SG1-04.ko: 흙으로 이마에 금을 긋고 무리가 노려봄
SG1-04.cast: a thumb drags gritty earth across skin with a dry scrape, a hush falls, and then a wolf pack's low interested growls rise, sinking and sharp, locking onto the mark

MG-13.ko: 갑옷 벗겨진 몸을 바위 주먹이 내리쳐 뼈가 부서짐
MG-13.cast: a stone-heavy fist winds up with a grinding rumble, slams down on bare flesh with a deep meaty impact, and a sharp crunching crack of bone splinters ring out over a gravelly settle

MG-16.cast: a vast hollow groan beneath the earth, a long cascading roar of crumbling rock and soil, a sudden drop with a whooshing fall, and a heavy settling boom with rolling debris

SG1-08.ko: 궁지에 몰린 무리가 송곳니를 드러내고 으르렁
SG1-08.cast: a cornered pack's deep chesty snarl swells, hides creak as bodies brace and thicken, and fangs snap shut together with a wet sharp clack that hangs in the air

SG1-09.ko: 무리가 한 덩어리로 몸을 던져 부딪침
SG1-09.cast: a heavy group charge of thudding feet, then a massive meaty collision boom, bodies grunting in pain on both sides, and gravel scattering

RG1-1.ko: 무리가 한꺼번에 몸을 던져 모두 스러짐
RG1-1.cast: a pack's pounding all-in charge converges, a crashing collision of bodies and weapons, a silence cut by a final sharp crack, then only the soft wind through dry grass

NG1-1.cast: a laboured ragged breathing slows and thickens, a thudding heartbeat swells and distorts, bones groaning with strain, then a violent snapping release like a drawn bowstring

NG1-2.cast: a single wolf howl is joined by another and another, snarling layers swell into a huge wall of growls and beast bellows sweeping across a field, flapping banners and cloth

US-G1-1.ko: 칼을 던져 결투를 걸고 먼저 침
US-G1-1.cast: a heavy blade is flung and sticks into the dirt with a hard thunk, boots circle in gravel, a quick lightning-fast strike clangs first, and a returning counterblow rings out

US-G1-2.ko: 무리의 발 구름에 용이 잠결에 뒤척임
US-G1-2.cast: many stomps land together, the ground thunders and pebbles dance, a colossal presence turns over beneath the crust with a huge grinding groan and a wide rolling quake

PS-G1-1.cast: several rough pack snarls join one by one into a rising layered howl, heavy fists thumping leather chests, and a far-off wall of stone crumbling under the rumble

PS-G1-2.cast: a single alpha snarl rises, and one by one the pack answers with growls of the same pitch, bristling fur and clicking claws spreading like a wave until all are matched

RS-G1-1.ko: 늑대가 먼저 물고 오크가 갑옷을 찢음
RS-G1-1.cast: a silent rustle in tall grass, a sudden wolf lunge and a snapping bite, then a heavy blade ripping through the gap with a tearing metallic rasp and screech

RS-G1-2.ko: 손바닥을 갈라 피를 섞으며 무리가 맹세함
RS-G1-2.cast: a short blade slices across a palm with a wet hiss, several fists clasp together with a meaty slap, a low rumble of guttural grunts swears as one, and a deep heartbeat thumps twice under a warm swelling hum

RS-G1-3.cast: a single fist rises with a creaking leather squeal, slams the ground with a flat boom, then a long jagged crack races across rock with a ripping split and a rumble of shaking stone

CS-G1.cast: a wooden trap clicks half-open, a heavy boot comes down with a hard stomp, crushing it with a splintering crunch, a snapped spring pinging away and a fizzle of cut-off magic

I2-2.ko: 양날 도끼를 뽑아 한 방을 가늠
I2-2.equip: a double-bladed axe is drawn from a hide sling with a leathery rasp, the bone-carved handle thumps into a palm, and one wild test swing cuts the air with a heavy whoosh

IG1-1.equip: a curved claw is pressed against the back of a hand, a coarse thread tugs through leather with a quick stitching pull, and a flex of fingers makes it click sharply

M2-1.ko: 뼈 바늘로 앞발에 송곳니 문신을 새김
M2-1.equip: a bone needle taps rapidly into the skin of a forepaw like tiny pecks, a dry scratch of pigment, then the paw flexes with a leathery creak and a faint tearing rasp like fang through hide

IG1-3.equip: red pigment is rubbed into skin with a rasp, then a hot slow sizzle as the mark glows, blood pulses thickly, and a leather armband creaks tight over swelling muscle

IG1-4.ko: 작은 바위 토템을 등에 지고 묶음
IG1-4.equip: a small rock totem is lifted from the ground with a gritty scrape, tied with rope that creaks, and slung onto a back with a soft thump, a pebble clicking inside it

IG1-6.ko: 전쟁 도끼를 어깨에 걸고 갑옷을 가늠
IG1-6.equip: a heavy war axe is wrenched from a stone rack with a scrape, its iron head thumps across a shoulder pad, and a chain-mail chime rings as the edge slices air

IR-G1.equip: ash is ground in a stone bowl, a bone needle pricks quickly, and as the mark settles a cold sharp ping rings, like a blade finding its point with a tiny dry snap

PI-G1.ko: 낡은 결투 장갑을 끼고 주먹을 쥠
PI-G1.equip: a heavy worn gauntlet is slid onto a fist with metal scraping leather, buckles snap shut one after another, and a clenched knuckle crack booms with a deep stony ring

TK-G1-1.ko: 그림자에서 튀어나와 한 번 물고 사라짐 · 맞으면 연기처럼 흩어짐
TK-G1-1.atk: a faint giggle from the shadows, a silent pounce, a single bone-crunching snap of jaws, and a fading cackle as it melts away
TK-G1-1.def: no guard, the shadowy body gives way: a brief airy puff as the hit passes through, a thin whine, and smoke dispersing without any solid thud

TK-G1-2.ko: 무리 우두머리가 덮쳐 뼈째 묾 · 두꺼운 갈기로 막음
TK-G1-2.atk: a low commanding whoop, heavy paws thudding over soil, a lunge, then a crushing bite that cracks bone and a short furious shake of the head
TK-G1-2.def: a thick bristly mane takes the blow: a solid dull thump, a deep warning growl, claws digging into dirt and a heavy body barely moving back

TK-U-WOLF.ko: 달려와 재빨리 물고 지나감 · 몸을 틀어 비켜 맞음
TK-U-WOLF.atk: light fast pawsteps rushing across dry grass, a breathy giggle, a swift snapping bite and then a quick scrabble away
TK-U-WOLF.def: it twists to take a glancing hit on its flank: a soft muffled thump on grey-spotted fur, a short startled yip, claws skidding in dirt
